title: Bing Chilling
blurb: John Cena, in Mandarin, holding an ice cream, promoting a Fast and Furious film with more sincerity than the situation could possibly require. The clip resurfaced in 2021 and the internet adopted it wholesale, mostly because of the delivery — very good, very nice — which is so committed that it loops back around to genuinely charming. It works as a greeting, a non-sequitur, or a way to derail any conversation that has become too serious. Bing chilling is simply the Mandarin for ice cream, and somehow that is the least interesting part.
origin: John Cena's viral Mandarin ice cream video.
